newsitem.title: USA: US corporate debt mart girds for new junk issues.
newsitem.headline: US corporate debt mart girds for new junk issues.

text.p: U.S. corporate bond players on Monday were bracing for another busy week in which issuers were expected to sell over $1 billion in new high-yield bonds.
Most syndicate officials were optimistic that investors in the primary market would be able to absorb the heavy new supply without driving the yield on new issues to prohibitively high levels.

A syndicate source said he was optimistic about supply and demand technicals because he believed lower Treasury rates were likely to induce retail investors to invest more money in high-yield mutual funds in search of better returns.
